title: config.rs: DKIM public_key_b64 not validated against seed — mismatched keypair silently produces invalid signatures
description: config.rs validate(): both key_seed_b64 and public_key_b64 are validated for correct length (32 bytes each) but they are never validated as a matching Ed25519 keypair. A misconfigured public key that does not match the seed will produce a DkimSigner that generates signatures which fail verification at the receiving MTA. The error will not surface until delivery — the server starts and runs normally but all outbound DKIM signatures are invalid. Ed25519Key::from_seed_and_public_key() validates the pair; this should be called at validation time (before the secretx path, or separately noted that secretx URIs cannot be pre-validated).
